subject.title: feat: add interactive launcher menu as thin wrapper over existing CLI

question: Should OpenClaw core own a new Rust interactive launcher wrapper, or should launcher ergonomics stay in the existing onboarding/native companion surfaces?
rationale: The remaining blockers include fixable code defects, but the central decision is a new user-facing core launcher and build surface that overlaps existing setup, dashboard, gateway, update, TUI, and native app ownership.

options.title: Keep launcher out of core
options.body: Keep onboarding and native companion apps as the canonical launch surfaces, and close or redirect this branch unless a maintainer sponsors a narrower design.

options.title: Sponsor a core launcher
options.body: Keep the PR open only after maintainer sponsorship, then require cleanup, exact delegation, packaging ownership, focused tests, and real behavior proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Keep launcher out of core
recommendation.body: Keep onboarding and native companion apps as the canonical launch surfaces, and close or redirect this branch unless a maintainer sponsors a narrower design.

likelyOwner.reason: The history hunt ties this person to several of the wrapped setup, macOS, dashboard readiness, TUI, and update surfaces.
